items.question: How do I book an appointment?
items.answer: Use the booking form on this site, or call +91 89148 05523. The form sends your request to the clinic on WhatsApp.

items.question: Where is the clinic?
items.answer: Dr. Gowthami sees patients at Medlife Multi Speciality Hospital, Collectorate Junction, Maharani Peta, Visakhapatnam 530002.

items.question: What does Dr. Gowthami treat?
items.answer: Gynecology, pregnancy care, preventive care, wellness checks and cancer screening, for women at every stage of life.

items.question: Can I come for a check-up if nothing is wrong?
items.answer: Yes. Regular check-ups help find problems early. Ask about a wellness check or preventive screening.

items.question: Should I share my medical reports in the booking form?
items.answer: No. The form only asks for your name, phone number, preferred date and reason. Bring your reports to your visit.

items.question: What should I do in an emergency?
items.answer: Do not wait for an appointment. Call 112 or go to the nearest hospital emergency department.
